# CollisionNZ

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Collisions](Blitz3D-Collisions)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
CollisionNZ:Float32 entity:Int32, collision_index:Int32
```

## Description

**Works in:** Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | Int32 | required | The entity that moved. |
| `collision_index` | Int32 | required |  |

**Returns:** The Z part of the surface normal at the numbered collision.
